meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你把消息渠道(如 Telegram、Slack)接到 agent 分组上,选择隔离级别、添加新渠道群组,并汇总当前哪些渠道已接、已配置未接、未配置。
howto.when: 在添加渠道之后、初始化设置过程中,或想重新配置接线时触发。

say.text: 把刚加的 Telegram 群接到现有的 agent 分组
显示当前 agent 分组和它们接的渠道
say.note: 列出已接、已配置未接、未配置

say.text: 把这个渠道从旧分组改接到新分组

howto.what_en: Claude wires messaging channels to agent groups, picks isolation levels, adds new channel groups, and summarizes which channels are wired, configured-but-unwired, or unconfigured.
howto.when_en: Use after adding a channel, during setup, or when you want to reconfigure wirings.

say_en.text: Wire the Telegram group I just added to my existing agent group
say_en.note: Pairs first, then creates the wiring

say_en.text: Show my agent groups and the channels wired to them
Move this channel from the old agent group to a new one
say_en.note: Old sessions stay with the old group
